description: §4.12.2 (S445 item 3) control — session attributes on the file's TOP-LEVEL `<program>` (wrapped in a `<div>`, which never changes a program's role, §4.12) are the application's own session configuration: no E-PROGRAM-NESTED-SESSION, no error.
rationale: §4.12.2: only a NESTED `<program>` may not carry a session attribute; §4.12: a `<div>`-wrapped program with no `<program>`/`<page>` ancestor is top-level.
